title: "Live Flight Monitor"

<script>
function filterFlights() {
  const input = document.getElementById('flightSearchInput');
  const filter = input.value.toUpperCase();
  const table = document.getElementById('flightMonitoringTable');
  if (!table) return;
  const tr = table.getElementsByTagName('tr');
  let matchCount = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < tr.length; i++) {
    const text = tr[i].textContent || tr[i].innerText;
    if (text.toUpperCase().indexOf(filter) > -1) {
      tr[i].style.display = '';
      matchCount++;
    } else {
      tr[i].style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
  const badge = document.getElementById('flightCountBadge');
  if (badge) {
    badge.innerText = `${matchCount} FLIGHTS`;
  }
  const notice = document.getElementById('noMatchNotice');
  if (notice) {
    notice.className = matchCount === 0 ? 'p-4 text-center text-muted' : 'p-4 text-center text-muted d-none';
  }
}

// Read URL search parameter if present
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const q = params.get('search');
  if (q) {
    const input = document.getElementById('flightSearchInput');
    if (input) {
      input.value = q;
      filterFlights();
    }
  }
});
</script>
